mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_upstream_command (order_no, command_type, transport, payload, status, attempt_count, next_retry_at, owner, claimed_at, last_error) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{commandType}, #{transport}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{owner}, #{claimedAt}, #{lastError})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_upstream_command WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND command_type = #{commandType}

SELECT * FROM t_upstream_command WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW(3))) OR (status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND claimed_at < NOW(3) - INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE t_upstream_command SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS', owner = #{owner}, claimed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id IN #{id}
UPDATE t_upstream_command SET status = 'SENT' WHERE id = #{id} AND owner = #{owner} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'

UPDATE t_upstream_command SET status = #{status}, attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{backoffMicros} MICROSECOND), last_error = #{lastError}, owner = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND owner = #{owner} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
